rows.name: Official-scoring side model
rows.hypothesis: A fair spread built only from officially sourced scoring and standings numbers will differ from the market enough to beat the closing number.
rows.inputs: Points for, points against, net points, home/road splits, official team offensive and defensive stats
rows.status: Paper — inputs verified, outcomes not yet computable

rows.name: Official-stats total model
rows.hypothesis: A game total estimated from official offensive and defensive pace and efficiency stats will differ from the market total.
rows.inputs: Official offensive and defensive passing, rushing, receiving, scoring and downs stats
rows.status: Paper — inputs verified, outcomes not yet computable

rows.name: Injury-driven line adjustment
rows.hypothesis: A starter ruled Out who has to be replaced by a 3rd or 4th string player is a larger negative than the market prices.
rows.inputs: Official injury report game status, official club depth chart string number
rows.status: Paper — inputs verified, outcomes not yet computable

rows.name: Deficiency mismatch (offensive line vs pass rush)
rows.hypothesis: When a team's offensive line is starting backups against a top official pass-rush defence, the total and the side both move more than the market allows for.
rows.inputs: Official depth chart offensive-line slots, official injury statuses, official defensive passing stats
rows.status: Paper — inputs verified, outcomes not yet computable

rows.name: Low-correlation multi-game parlay
rows.hypothesis: Parlaying legs that are near-independent by construction has the same expected value as the legs but a much larger variance, which is only worth taking when each leg clears the edge gate on its own.
rows.inputs: Correlation matrix from official team stats, per-leg edge estimates
rows.status: Paper — correlation values computed, leg edges not yet computable

_flags: outcome metrics cannot be computed until a results feed exists (Q-04)
rows.name: Same-game correlation-aware parlay
rows.hypothesis: A same-game parlay is only rational when the two legs are positively correlated, because that raises the joint probability above the product of the legs.
rows.inputs: Game-level correlation estimates — NOT AVAILABLE from any verified official source
rows.status: Blocked — no game-level official data (see Q-10, Q-21)
